description.narrative: The development objective of the Electricity Sector Development Project is to improve the reliability of and increase the access to electricity supply in the southwest region of Uganda. There are three components to the project. The first components of the project includes the construction of 137 km of 220 kV Kawanda-Masaka transmission line and related substation construction/upgrades and resettlement of displaced persons. The second component of the project is includes the technical assistance in support of project implementation, transmission system development and capacity building of Uganda Electricity Transmission Company Ltd. (UETCL); and the third component of the project includes the community support projects in areas affected by the transmission line construction and capacity building at Ministry of Energy and Mineral Development (MEMD).
The project development objective is to improve the reliability of and increase the access to electricity supply in the southwest region of Uganda
